---
title: "04 miRNA Compare"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
initialize_profile_comparison_module(
  environment(),
  MIRNA_COMPARE_FIG,
  MIRNA_COMPARE_TAB,
  "04_mirna_compare",
  c(
    "01_composition",
    "02_annotation_trends",
    "03_length_distribution",
    "04_sample_qc",
    "05_top_annotations"
  )
)
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

```{r build-mirna-inputs, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
mirna_sample_total <- sample_comp_view %>%
  filter(as.character(MainCategory) == "miRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_group_total <- mirna_sample_total %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("MainCategory") %>%
  left_join(group_clean_reads_tbl, by = "Group") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_detail <- output_all %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "miRNA", !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation), PrimaryAnnotation != "", PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

# 注释层使用 SPORTS summary 的分数计数；序列层 detail 保留原始完整注释。
mirna_annotation_sample <- sports_annotation_counts() %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "miRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

mirna_annotation_group <- mirna_annotation_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
  left_join(
    mirna_annotation_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("PrimaryAnnotation") %>%
      select(Group, PrimaryAnnotation, Percent),
    by = c("Group", "PrimaryAnnotation")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Percent = replace_na(Percent, 0))

mirna_levels <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(PrimaryAnnotation)

if (length(mirna_levels) == 0) {
  mirna_levels <- unique(as.character(mirna_annotation_group$PrimaryAnnotation))
}

mirna_palette <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(max(1, length(mirna_levels)), palette = "Set 3"), mirna_levels)
mirna_annotation_trend <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(PrimaryAnnotation %in% mirna_levels) %>%
  transmute(Group, TrendCategory = PrimaryAnnotation, Reads, Percent)

mirna_length_group <- group_length_view %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "miRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

mirna_sample_detection <- mirna_annotation_sample %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    DetectedMiRNAs = n_distinct(PrimaryAnnotation[Reads > 0]),
    MiRNAReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(sample_info %>% transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Group = as.character(Group)),
             by = c("Sample", "Group")) %>%
  mutate(DetectedMiRNAs = coalesce(DetectedMiRNAs, 0L), MiRNAReads = coalesce(MiRNAReads, 0)) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    MiRNAReadFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * MiRNAReads / CleanReads, 0),
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)
  )

mirna_feature_matrix <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  mirna_annotation_sample,
  feature_col = "PrimaryAnnotation",
  sample_order = as.character(sample_info$Sample),
  feature_order = mirna_levels,
  min_total = 0
)

mirna_correlation_tbl <- tibble()
if (nrow(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2 && ncol(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2) {
  mirna_cor <- cor(log2(mirna_feature_matrix$matrix + 1), method = "pearson")
  mirna_cor_order <- rownames(mirna_cor)
  if (nrow(mirna_cor) > 1) {
    mirna_cor_order <- rownames(mirna_cor)[hclust(as.dist(1 - mirna_cor), method = "complete")$order]
  }
  mirna_correlation_tbl <- expand.grid(sample_x = mirna_cor_order, sample_y = mirna_cor_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation <- as.vector(mirna_cor[mirna_cor_order, mirna_cor_order])
}

mirna_top_annotations <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  filter(RPM > 0 | Reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = RPM, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

mirna_top_annotations_overall <- mirna_annotation_group %>%
  group_by(PrimaryAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), PrimaryAnnotation)
```

```{r mirna-composition, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(mirna_group_total) > 0) {
  mirna_total_plot <- build_two_group_summary_bar(
    mirna_sample_total,
    "Percent",
    "miRNA abundance across groups",
    "Mean percent of clean reads per sample",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = group_palette,
    sample_info = sample_info,
    label_digits = 1
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_total_plot,
    "01_composition",
    "mirna_group_total_percent.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

if (nrow(mirna_annotation_trend) > 0 && length(mirna_levels) >= 2) {
  mirna_bar <- build_trend_bar_plot(
    mirna_annotation_trend,
    mirna_levels,
    "Percent",
    "miRNA annotation proportions across groups",
    "Proportion within miRNA (%)",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = mirna_palette
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_bar,
    "02_annotation_trends",
    "mirna_annotation_percent_bar.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  mirna_alluvial <- build_trend_alluvial_plot(
    mirna_annotation_trend,
    mirna_levels,
    "Percent",
    "miRNA annotation alluvial across groups",
    "Proportion within miRNA (%)",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = mirna_palette
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_alluvial,
    "02_annotation_trends",
    "mirna_annotation_percent_alluvial.pdf",
    width = 10.5,
    height = 6.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r mirna-length, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(mirna_length_group) > 0) {
  mirna_length_line <- ggplot(mirna_length_group %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  mirna_length_bar <- ggplot(mirna_length_group %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  mirna_length_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(mirna_length_line, mirna_length_bar),
    title_text = "miRNA length comparison across groups",
    cols = 1
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_length_plot,
    "03_length_distribution",
    "mirna_length_compare.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r mirna-qc, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(mirna_correlation_tbl) > 0) {
  mirna_cor_values <- mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation[is.finite(mirna_correlation_tbl$correlation)]
  mirna_cor_min <- if (length(mirna_cor_values) > 0) min(mirna_cor_values) else 0
  if (!is.finite(mirna_cor_min) || mirna_cor_min >= 1) mirna_cor_min <- 0.95
  mirna_cor_plot <- ggplot(mirna_correlation_tbl, aes(sample_x, sample_y, fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), sprintf("%.2f", correlation), "")), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = serum_diverging_palette,
      limits = c(mirna_cor_min, 1),
      na.value = serum_neutral_line
    ) +
    labs(title = "Sample correlation from miRNA annotations", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_cor_plot,
    "04_sample_qc",
    "mirna_sample_correlation_heatmap.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 6.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

mirna_detection_plot <- ggplot(mirna_sample_detection, aes(x = Sample, y = DetectedMiRNAs, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DetectedMiRNAs), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Detected miRNA annotations per sample", x = NULL, y = "Number of detected miRNA annotations") +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())

save_plot_nested(
  mirna_detection_plot,
  "04_sample_qc",
  "mirna_detected_annotations.pdf",
  width = 8.3,
  height = 5.2,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r mirna-top-annotations, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(mirna_top_annotations) > 0) {
  annotation_order <- mirna_top_annotations_overall$PrimaryAnnotation
  mirna_top_annotations <- mirna_top_annotations %>%
    mutate(PrimaryAnnotation = factor(PrimaryAnnotation, levels = rev(annotation_order)))

  mirna_top_plot <- ggplot(mirna_top_annotations, aes(x = PrimaryAnnotation, y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, position = position_dodge(width = 0.78)) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Top miRNA annotations per group", x = NULL, y = "RPM") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))

  save_plot_nested(
    mirna_top_plot,
    "05_top_annotations",
    "mirna_top_annotations.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 7.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

write_csv_safe(mirna_group_total, "mirna_group_total.csv")
write_csv_safe(mirna_annotation_group, "mirna_annotation_group.csv")
write_csv_safe(mirna_sample_detection, "mirna_sample_detection.csv")
write_csv_safe(mirna_top_annotations, "mirna_top_annotations.csv")
```

miRNA analysis completed.
